cc:Work.dc:description: Report-derived values; 6 unique cells / 1,920 runs total, each point 40 tasks x 2 repeats. Vector/Utility success rates overlap. Snapshot selection with Top-k=5; this is not 1,000 online agent turns. No marginal CIs supplied for every point. Sources: docs/experiments/reports/long-horizon-analysis-2026-11-11.md; docs/experiments/reports/state-update-h100-analysis-2026-11-11.md
